full_prompt_en: A square, heavily textured painted close-up shows a blue-eyed face built from vivid fractured color. The face fills the frame edge to edge, with the upper forehead, chin, and much of the mouth cropped away. Two clear blue eyes occupy the upper third and stare outward from beneath dark, roughly brushed brows. The left eye is surrounded by violet-black shadow and a warm orange lower lid; the right eye sits inside a dark navy brow and crimson-pink shadow. A long pale blue-gray nose descends through the center, its lit ridge sharply distinct from the saturated cheek fields. On the left, yellow and orange pigment covers the cheek in layered, chipped patches, with hints of green visible beneath. On the right, crimson, rose, lavender, and blue blocks stack around the eye and cheek; a narrow band of yellow-green warms the side of the nose. At the lower edge, only part of the lips and darker blue shadows remain visible, so the steady gaze dominates the composition. Thick, irregular paint marks, scraped patches, and fine cracks give every colored area a rough physical surface. The facial structure stays recognizable because darker accents around the eyes and nostrils remain carefully placed amid the abstract blocks. There is almost no independent background; color and face are one continuous painted field. Light is expressed through the cool pale ridge of the nose, small wet-looking highlights in the irises, and brighter ochre patches against dark blue-violet shadows. The overall composition is bold and confrontational, balancing realistic eye detail with broad, weathered planes of complementary color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、肌理厚重的绘画特写呈现一张由鲜艳破碎色彩搭建的蓝眼睛面容。面孔从边到边填满画幅，上额、下巴和大部分嘴巴都被裁去。两只清晰蓝眼睛占据上三分之一，在粗刷的深眉下直望画外。左眼周围是紫黑色阴影与暖橙下眼睑；右眼则处在深海军蓝眉毛和绯红粉色阴影内。一道长长的浅蓝灰鼻梁穿过中央，受光的鼻脊与饱和的脸颊色域鲜明分离。左侧，黄与橙色颜料以层叠剥落斑块覆盖脸颊，底下透出少量绿色。右侧，绯红、玫瑰、薰衣草紫和蓝色块堆叠在眼睛与脸颊周围；一道窄黄绿色带温暖鼻侧。下缘只剩部分嘴唇与较深蓝影，因此稳定的目光主导构图。厚而不规则的颜料痕、刮去的斑片与细裂纹让每块颜色都具有粗糙实体表面。面部结构仍可辨认，因为眼睛与鼻孔周围的暗色重音在抽象色块中保持准确位置。几乎没有独立背景；颜色与面孔构成一片连续的绘画场。光由冷浅色鼻脊、虹膜中细小湿亮高光和对照深蓝紫阴影的较亮赭色斑块表现。整体构图大胆而直面观者，在写实眼部细节与宽阔风化的互补色平面之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The painted style constructs volume from thick, irregular patches of strongly contrasting color rather than smooth blended skinlike gradients. Scraped edges, small fissures, and layered pigment create a worn impasto surface, while selected focal details are rendered with much finer precision. Cobalt and navy sit beside hot orange, yellow, crimson, green, and lavender; adjacent warm and cool blocks model depth through color temperature as much as value. Dark accents concentrate around key internal contours, allowing the broader forms to remain fractured without losing legibility. Nearly the whole frame is occupied by color and texture, producing close visual pressure with little empty ground. Directional highlights are sparse and localized, appearing as cool pale planes or tiny bright points against deep chromatic shadow. The overall effect is vivid and tactile, joining representational control to coarse, expressive paint handling.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画风格以厚而不规则、对比强烈的色片搭建体积，而不是平顺融合的皮肤式渐层。刮擦边缘、细小裂纹与层叠颜料形成磨旧厚涂表面，少数焦点细节则以更精确的笔触完成。钴蓝和海军蓝紧挨热橙、黄色、绯红、绿色及薰衣草紫；相邻冷暖块面以色温和明度共同塑造纵深。深色重音集中在关键内部轮廓，使宽阔形体即使破碎仍保持可读。几乎整个画幅都由颜色和肌理占满，留白很少，形成贴近的视觉压力。定向高光稀疏且局部化，成为对照浓重彩色暗影的冷浅色平面或细小亮点。整体效果鲜活且可触，把具象控制与粗粝富表现力的颜料运用结合起来。
theme_en: A blue-eyed face painted in vivid fractured color
theme_zh: 一张蓝眼睛面容以鲜艳破碎色块绘成
name: Michael Creese
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
